Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick intake on Redwood Inference's publisher enrollment. We're the Contoso Marketplace team handling the listing side and we need a couple of identity artifacts before we can proceed to technical validation: tenant ID, a service principal proof-of-control (audit-type JSON), and confirmation of the publisher account admin.

I've attached our standard "azure-onboard-checklist.pdf" that shows required fields. Two quick clarifications we get asked about frequently:
- We accept either a delegated service principal (App + secret/certificate) or a managed identity with delegated consent; please indicate which you plan to provide.
- For least-privilege, we typically require Contributor on the specific subscription/resource group + Owner on the Publisher resource (or equivalent RBAC claims).

Could you confirm ETA for the artifacts? If easier, we can schedule a 30-min technical handoff next week.

Thanks,

Hi Lina — good call. See answers and next steps below.

1) Proof artifact fields (what we'll provide)
- publisher: "Redwood Inference"
- timestamp_utc: ISO8601 UTC timestamp
- tenant_id: GUID
- appId: GUID (application id)
- objectId: GUID (service principal object id)
- cert_thumbprint: SHA1 fingerprint of uploaded cert
- signature: base64 of signed payload (we'll sign with the private key corresponding to cert)
- validation_steps: list describing how we uploaded the cert and verified ownership

We will upload the public certificate to the App registration and include the uploaded cert thumbprint in the proof JSON. We'll also include a short, signed statement (signature) that the cert was created by Redwood and tied to the publisher account admin.

2) RBAC / scope: we can create SP at subscription scope for your initial validation. Once validated we'll follow up with a narrower resource-group-level SP for the production listing.

3) Attached I've included our generated proof stub (service-principal-proof.json) and a filled publisher-claim-template.docx for Contoso to sign if that matches your intake flow.

4) Runbook summary (excerpt):
- create app registration (az ad app create --display-name "redwood-marketplace-sp")
- upload cert (az ad app credential reset --id <appId> --cert @pubcert.pem)
- create service principal (az ad sp create --id <appId>)
- assign role at subscription: az role assignment create --assignee <objectId> --role "Contributor" --scope /subscriptions/<subId>
- export proof JSON: include timestamps and thumbprint, sign using private key, store in secure bucket and share with partner link

If this looks good we'll spin up the test SP tomorrow morning (PST) and send the final signed proof. Also happy to join a 20-30 min call Tuesday 8/20 to walk through the proof if Contoso wants live verification.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
